there are statistically differences in QOL among higher education students due to gender and accumulative average.
there are statistically differences in QOL among students due to some variables, and there is a positive relationship between cognitive flexibility and QL among students.

there is a statistically positive significant relationship between QoL (overall scale) & cognitive flexibility (overall) among students, there is a positive significant relationship between adaptive flexibility and dimensions of quality of life (quality of health & education & learning & emotional life & mental health & time management) and there is no relationship between spontaneous flexibility and social & family life and emotional.

the QOL and its relationship with cognitive flexibility among students enrolled in AlBalqa’ Applied university.
the relationship between quality of life and cognitive flexibility among higher university education students.
cognitive flexibility and its relationship to the quality of life among students.

QOL is positively related to cognitive flexibility, and the higher the QOL, the greater the cognitive flexibility, and vice versa.
there is a statistically positive significant relationship between QL (overall scale) of higher education students and their adaptive and spontaneous cognitive flexibility.
the quality of life among higher education students has been affected by the gender, accumulative averages, and cognitive flexibility.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
QOL and cognitive flexibility are positively associated.
the study outcomes indicated that higher education students’ quality of life is affected by gender, accumulative averages, and cognitive flexibility.
